import_approvals.rationale: Finite-PMF Pinsker combines existing half-L1 TV and unconditional KL map data processing with private closed-interval binary analysis. The Real and square-root consequences first derive finite KL from support inclusion. Focused analytic and tactic imports support the proofs; no coupling/gluing or root dependency is added. The direct Sqrt import names the owner of the square-root conversion lemma instead of relying on its incidental transitive exposure through derivative analysis. Quantitative independence reuses the existing joint absolute-continuity and MI-as-KL interfaces through the same imports; finite KL is established privately before conversion.
import_approvals.consumer: LeanInfoTheory.Examples.Pinsker imports the focused owner and exercises Boolean boundaries, positive three-atom reduction, both finite-KL guards, a sparse reference law, extended-valued event budgets and actual singular counterexamples. LeanInfoTheory.Examples.QuantitativeIndependence imports the same focused owner and checks MI budgets, events, unit-interval and signed tests, arbitrary-source pushforwards and an exact sparse joint with a null marginal row.
